shortDescription: Library mod: gives any pawn randomly rolled, hidden-until-discovered titan traits and materials, with naming, inheritance, visuals, light, ability AI and player settings. Content mods define the traits.
body:
## Purpose
Library mod for a later dungeon mod. Gives any pawn (animal, humanlike, mech) a set of rolled traits and a material. Content mods define the traits; this mod handles storage, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, visuals, light, materials, ability AI and hiding of undiscovered traits.

## Status
- Phase 1 (tested): traits, titan hediff, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, debug actions.
- Visuals, materials (run #28), light (run #29), mod settings (tabs).
- Phase 3 step 1, ability AI: tested run #31. Lead-in discovery: tested run #34.
- Phase 3 step 2, hiding undiscovered traits: tested (summary commit 6702505).
- **Phase 3 step 3, Biotech humanlike birth inheritance: tested run #49 (build 45).** Includes material inheritance for humans (user wants it).
- Phase 3 remaining: diet traits (FoodUtility.WillEat), optional VRE gene compat.

## Startup
- Settings load in the Mod constructor. Harmony PatchAll runs in `[StaticConstructorOnStartup] TitanPatcher`, after defs load. Patching from the Mod constructor ran PregnancyUtility's static constructor before DefOfs existed and broke every pawn generation (run #48). Lore saved.

## Inheritance (Source/Patches.cs, TitanUtility.InheritTraits)
- BirthContext records both parents: Hediff_Pregnant.DoBirthSpawn (animals), CompHatcher.Hatch (eggs; otherParent only if genders differ), PregnancyUtility.ApplyBirthOutcome (Biotech humans and growth vats; genetic mother + father).
- TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn prefix applies before spawn and sets `applied`. ApplyBirthOutcome postfix covers the doctor-carry branch (no spawn). Stillborn gets nothing.
- Material from a parent (coin flip if both), then each heritable non-material trait with 1-(1-chance×setting)^carriers. Starts discovered if a parent had it discovered.

## Ability AI (Source/TitanAI.cs)
- Postfix on Pawn_JobTracker.DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob runs JobGiver_TitanAbilities when the constant tree gave nothing (every 30 ticks).
- Guards: titan, spawned, awake, not downed/burning/drafted, not a player colonist, not in a non-aggro mental state, not already casting. Setting `abilityAI`.
- Order: trait `aiThinkTree`s; offensive trait abilities at the current enemy; self-targeted non-offensive trait abilities. All through vanilla AICanTargetNow.
- Content note: abilities for animals need `displayGizmoWhileUndrafted` or tamed titans never show the button (user declined forcing it).

## Discovery of ability traits
- Normal: Notify_PawnUsedVerb when the ability resolves. Lead-in: Ability.Notify_StartedCasting prefix+postfix wraps this cast's preCastActions so the reveal happens when the visible effect starts.
- Gap: world-target abilities cast from a caravan don't reveal.

## Hiding undiscovered traits (Source/TitanHiding.cs)
- During StatsReportUtility.DrawStatsReport(Rect, Thing) for a titan with hidden traits: Hediff_Titan.CurStage returns a discovered-only stage; hediffs granted only by hidden traits return null stage (Hediff.CurStage getter postfix); capacities dirtied and stat caches cleared before and after.
- Not hidden: pain/bleed totals, comps of hidden hediffs, hediff classes overriding CurStage, health tab capacities.
- Ability.GizmosVisible postfix hides abilities granted only by undiscovered traits.

## Mod settings (TitanSettings)
Tabs: Lights and effects / Traits / Materials. lightsEnabled, lightFollowCells, lightRadiusFactor, effectsEnabled; inheritChanceFactor, discoveryMessages, abilityAI; materialArmorFactor, materialDamageStrength, fireWeaknessStrength, butcherYieldPerBodySize, smallVolumeMultiplier, materialMarketValue.

## TitanTraitDef
Generation (commonality, pointCost, exclusionTags, race filters), discovery (visible, discoverWhen, discoveryMessage), naming (namePrefix/Suffix/Order), inheritance (heritable, inheritChance), effects (stage, hediffs with becomeVisible=false, abilities, aiThinkTree, traitClass), visuals (overlays, flames, effecters, glow).

## Harmony patches (21)
BestKindLabel; ApplyBirthOutcome prefix/postfix/finalizer; DoBirthSpawn prefix/finalizer; CompHatcher.Hatch prefix/finalizer; TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn; DropBloodFilth/DropBloodSmear; MakeCorpse; Corpse.IngestibleNow; Pawn.ButcherProducts; DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob; Ability.Notify_StartedCasting prefix+postfix; DrawStatsReport prefix+finalizer; Hediff.CurStage postfix; Ability.GizmosVisible postfix.

## Debug actions ("Titan Framework")
Add trait…, Roll traits…, Set material…, Discover all traits, Clear titan.

## Example content (Defs/Examples + Patches/TF_ExampleMaterials.xml): remove both together before publishing
Flaming, Venomous, Ironhide, Of the Deep, Brittle, Irradiated (Uranium), Firebreather (Biotech).
